member.name: T:CtxSignTool.Program
member.summary: Provides the main entry point and core logic for the ctxsigntool command-line application, enabling operations such as manifest generation, file signing, signature verification, certificate creation, and certificate pin extraction based on command-line arguments.
member.remarks: The Program class interprets command-line arguments to determine the requested operation mode and ensures that only one mode is selected per invocation. It supports displaying help and version information, and returns specific exit codes to indicate success or various error conditions. For detailed usage instructions and supported options, run the application with the '--help' argument.

member.name: M:CtxSignTool.Program.Main(System.String[])
member.summary: Serves as the entry point for the application, processing command-line arguments to perform operations such as generating manifests, signing files, verifying signatures, creating certificates, and printing certificate pins.
member.remarks: This method supports multiple command-line options and ensures that exactly one operation mode is selected per invocation. It provides help and version information when requested, and returns appropriate exit codes for various error conditions. For detailed usage instructions, run the application with the '--help' argument.
member.param: An array of command-line arguments that specify the operation to perform and provide necessary options or parameters for that operation.
member.returns: An integer exit code indicating the result of the operation. Returns 0 for success, 1 for general errors, and other specific codes for different failure conditions.
